We agree to discuss Cause, accrued entitlements, severance conditions and any legally permissible post-employment protections as a package, without agreement on individual provisions or economics at this stage. We have marked the outstanding terms expressly as subject to agreement and replaced the categorical non-compete with a placeholder pending review of governing law and work location. Please provide the particulars identified in your note, including the proposed salary and severance amounts or formulas, payment timing, benefits and conditions. All provisions remain subject to client approval and agreement on the complete document.

edits.text: PARTIES. This Agreement is between Vireo Systems Inc. and [Executive’s full legal name to be provided] (the “Executive”). Employment commencement date: [to be agreed].
2. COMPENSATION. Proposed Base Salary: [amount, currency and payment frequency to be agreed]. Benefits: [to be specified and agreed]. No compensation or benefits terms are agreed at this stage.

3. TERMINATION AND SEVERANCE. The definition of Cause, treatment of accrued compensation and benefits upon termination, and any severance entitlement upon termination without Cause remain to be agreed as part of the complete document. Severance amount or formula, payment timing and conditions: [to be agreed]. Any agreed provisions shall remain subject to applicable mandatory law.

4. POST-EMPLOYMENT PROTECTIONS. Any post-employment protections, including whether a non-compete is appropriate and legally permissible, remain subject to agreement following confirmation of governing law and the Executive’s principal work location. The nature, scope, duration and any required consideration for such protections are reserved for negotiation as part of the complete document. No twelve-month non-compete or other post-employment restriction is agreed at this stage.
